_comment: Single source of truth for benchmark numbers rendered via {{fact:<model-id>.<field>}} tokens in src/pages/. Every value must carry a source_url — scripts/build.mjs refuses to render a fact without one. protocol_note forces a '*' footnote suffix: vendors each run BEIR on their own dataset subset and first-stage retriever, so in practice every BEIR figure has one. verified_on drives a build-time staleness warning; it does not gate the build. scripts/check-sources.mjs (daily, real network) re-fetches each source and fails if the value is gone — check_url overrides what it fetches, check: "manual" + check_note skips a figure that only exists in an image.

beir.protocol_note: mixedbread's own cross-generation comparison table (mxbai-rerank-v2 README), evaluated for a fair v1-vs-v2 comparison rather than the classic BEIR 18-dataset suite other open-weight rows in this table use. Their original 2024 launch blog reported ~48.8 NDCG@10 on 11 BEIR datasets via Pyserini — in the same range, not the ~62.1 this site carried before Sep 2026.
